documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported a 53.3% YoY increase in revenue from operations to ₹ 472.2 crores for Q1 FY27, with profit after tax rising 42.9% YoY to ₹ 65.6 crores. The company is executing a ~₹ 200 crore capacity expansion program to increase its ABS capacity from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA, which is targeted for commissioning by September 30, 2026. This expansion is fully funded through internal accruals, and optimal utilization of the expanded capacity is expected by the end of FY28. Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported FY26 revenue of INR 1,276.0 crores, declining 8.7% YoY, while EBITDA grew 1.3% to INR 255.2 crores with a 20.0% margin. The company is executing an ongoing INR 200 crore debottlenecking capex, funded entirely via internal accruals, to expand ABS capacity from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA.

guidance.claim: The company expects optimal utilization of the expanded capacity by the end of FY28.
guidance.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand for ABS will be driven by robust growth in end-user industries like consumer durables and automotive.
demand_outlook.quote: Robust growth in end-user industries like consumer durables (air conditioners, refrigerators) and automotive will drive the domestic demand for ABS.

demand_outlook.claim: The global market is shifting toward specialty and colored grades, moving away from commoditized transparent resins.
demand_outlook.quote: The global market is shifting toward specialty & colored grades, moving away from commoditized transparent resins to higher-margin applications.

demand_outlook.claim: Electric vehicle adoption is accelerating the consumption of lightweight, high-performance plastics.
demand_outlook.quote: EV (Electric Vehicle) adoption is accelerating consumption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight, high-performance plastics for interior trims and battery housings.

demand_outlook.claim: Appliances and automotive continue to lead global ABS resin demand owing to impact resistance and aesthetic versatility.
demand_outlook.quote: Appliances and Automotive continue to dominate global demand for ABS resins due to their high impact resistance and aesthetic versatility.

demand_outlook.claim: The consumption of ABS in India is significantly larger than the combined output of domestic manufacturers, presenting growth opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: There is immense scope for growth, considering the existing supply and demand mismatch, and knowing the fact that the consumption of ABS in India is voluminously larger as compared to the combined output of the domestic manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian household appliances industry experienced healthy growth in FY 2025-26, driven by rising disposable incomes, urbanisation, and electrification.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian household appliances industry continued to witness healthy growth during FY 2025-26, supported by rising disposable incomes, increasing urbanisation, expanding electrification and growing consumer preference for premium and energy-efficient products.

demand_outlook.claim: The growing adoption of premium and energy-efficient appliances is driving demand for high-performance engineering plastics.
demand_outlook.quote: The increasing adoption of premium appliances, smart home solutions and energy-efficient products is driving demand for high-performance engineering plastics.

demand_outlook.claim: India's automobile industry achieved record annual sales of approximately 2.83 crore vehicles in FY 2025-26, reflecting strong demand.
demand_outlook.quote: India’s automobile industry recorded its highest-ever annual sales of approximately 2.83 crore vehicles in FY 2025-26, registering growth of 10.4% over the previous year, reflecting strong demand across passenger vehicles, two-wheelers, commercial vehicles and three-wheelers, supported by a series of structural policy reforms that have strengthened demand fundamentals and significantly boosted consumer confidence.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding its ABS capacity from 75,000 TPA to 100,000 TPA, with orders placed for critical long-delivery equipment.
capex_expansion.quote: The implementation of capacity expansion from existing 75000 TPA to 1,00,000 TPA is progressing well and orders have been placed for critical long delivery equipments.

capex_expansion.claim: The commissioning of the enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by the end of September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 was 19.2% compared to 20.0% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 44.5% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 92.3 crores, from ₹ 63.9 crores in Q1 FY26, with margins at 19.2% for Q1 FY27 as compared to 20.0% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA in Q4 FY26 grew by 33.1% YoY to INR 74.3 crores with margins reaching 21.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 33.1% YoY in Q4 FY26 to INR 74.3 crores, with margins at 21.8%; for FY26, EBITDA grew by 1.3% to INR 255.2 crores, with margins at 20.0%.

margins_costs.claim: The company's operating margin was 19.42% in FY 2025-26 compared to 17.43% in FY 2024-25, while the net profit margin stood at 14.14%.
margins_costs.quote: The operating margin for FY 2025-26 was 19.42 % as compared to 17.43 % for FY 2024-25, whereas the net profit margin stood at 14.14 % as compared to 12.86 % for the previous FY.

margins_costs.claim: The ABS business in India faces risks from foreign exchange fluctuations due to its dependence on imported raw materials like Styrene and Acrylonitrile.
margins_costs.quote: The ABS business in India is exposed to the risk of foreign exchange fluctuations, as the key raw materials viz. ‘Styrene’ and ‘Acrylonitrile’ are import dependent, as there is no indigenous producer for these monomers.

margins_costs.claim: Butadiene monomer is the only indigenously available raw material, making up about 15 percent of the total raw material composition.
margins_costs.quote: The only raw material which is indigenously available is Butadiene monomer, which constitutes around 15 per cent (weight wise) of the total raw material composition.

margins_costs.claim: The company has long-term contracts and maintains appropriate inventory levels to ensure a smooth supply of basic raw materials.
margins_costs.quote: The Company has long term contracts for smooth supply of basic raw materials and maintains appropriate level of inventories for smooth operations.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved a production volume of 71,601.50 TPA against an installed capacity of 75,000 TPA in FY 2025-26.
orders_capacity.quote: During FY 2025-26, the Company achieved a production volume of 71,601.50 TPA against installed capacity of 75,000 TPA.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volume for the year stood at 71,501.12 TPA compared to 74,381 TPA in the previous year.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume for the year stood at 71,501.12 TPA as compared to 74,381 TPA in FY 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: Consistent positive operating cash flows support self-funded growth without relying on external capital.
capital_allocation.quote: Consistent positive operating cash flows (CFO) support self-funded growth without reliance on external capital.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a debt-free balance sheet.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt-free balance sheet ensures zero financial risk and high resilience.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's healthy dividend payout reflects disciplined capital allocation.
capital_allocation.quote: Healthy dividend payout (~50%+)* reflects disciplined capital allocation and shareholder returns.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to maintain its status as a zero-debt company.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company continues to enjoy the status of a “Zero Debt Company”.

capital_allocation.claim: The company expects to sustain its business operations through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: There was no change in financing pattern and the Company would be able to sustain its business operations through internal accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: The board declared three interim dividends of Re. 1/- each and recommended a final dividend of Re. 1/- per share for the financial year ended 31st March, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Continuing with the practice of rewarding shareholders, the Board declared three Interim Dividends, each of Re.1/- (collectively 300%) per Equity shares of Re.1/- and recommended a Final Dividend of Re.1/- (100 %) per Equity Share for the Financial Year Ended 31st March, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The directors do not propose to transfer any amount to the General Reserve for the financial year ended 31st March, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: For the FY ended 31st March, 2026, the Directors do not propose to transfer any amount to the General Reserve.

risks_headwinds.claim: The global outlook has abruptly darkened following the outbreak of war in the Middle East on February 28, 2026.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global outlook has abruptly darkened following the outbreak of war in the Middle East on February 28, 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ABS business in India is exposed to the risk of foreign exchange fluctuations due to its dependence on imported raw materials.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ABS business in India is exposed to the risk of foreign exchange fluctuations, as the key raw materials viz. ‘Styrene’ and ‘Acrylonitrile’ are import dependent, as there is no indigenous producer for these monomers.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia pose external risks by affecting commodity and oil price volatility and global trade.
risks_headwinds.quote: While external risks arising from geopolitical tensions (particularly in West Asia) affecting commodity / oil prices volatility and global trade uncertainties remains, India’s domestic demand-driven growth model provides a strong foundation for long-term economic expansion.

management_commitments.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

management_commitments.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.
